Wine estate in Azeitão → villa in the Sintra hills → Comporta → Lisbon
Start slow among the vines, get competitive in a villa kitchen, end on the coast and a Lisbon rooftop. It's the easiest trip to reach from anywhere in Europe and the most relaxed of the four.
Pick-up in Lisbon, 40 minutes south to a wine estate in Azeitão. Check in, pool, settle.
Dinner at a long table in the vineyard. Your host opens the week with a short welcome, then everyone introduces themselves with a card.
Slow breakfast with scenario cards: it rains on your romantic weekend, now what?
Pairs are drawn and head out on one of five dates, lunch included.
Dinner at a restaurant with a view. Host's circle: what surprised you today?
Horseback through the estate, then a picnic

Into Alfama for dinner and fado. Host's circle on the challenge.
Recipe holders describe the ingredients without naming them.
List makers turn the descriptions into a shopping list, then hand it on.
Shoppers buy what's on the list without talking to the recipe holders. They don't know the budget.
Budget keepers know the limit and set the clock. If the receipt is over budget, the shoppers decide what goes back.
Cooks follow spoken instructions only and cook with whatever arrives.
The debrief is about the team, never about who was bossy. If it gets tense, the host brings it back to the shared win.

A dating show without the cruelty
Each trip runs as a season in three acts, with a host who sets the pace. Days 1 to 3 are for mixing, days 4 and 5 for choosing, and days 6 and 7 end in the Reveal.

Commit. Free time with whoever you like, private picks, and the Reveal at sunset.

Your date for the day is on the back of this card. Five dates run at once and nobody knows who got which until the cars leave. House rule until lunch: no talking about work.

On the way into Alfama, find an azulejo panel you both like. Each of you invents the story it tells in two sentences. Pick a winner. The loser chooses tomorrow's playlist.
Neither of you may choose the next stop. Flip a coin at every corner: heads, you decide; tails, your partner does. Whoever loses the last flip buys the pastéis de nata.

Around the farewell table, each person names one thing they're taking home from this week. It can be a person, a place or a dish.

Once this week, ask your host to move you into a different pair for the next activity. Use it quietly. Nobody is told who used it.

Single people roughly 26 to 38 (28 to 40 for Nairobi) who would rather meet someone over a kayak than a chat window. Every cohort holds an 8/8 balance, so women and men apply on separate lists.
Do I have to be looking for romance?
No. Many members come for the trip and the people. At the Reveal you pick romantic and friend connections, so the week ends with people to see again either way.
What if I don't match with anyone?
Picks are private and only mutual matches are announced, so nobody hears a no. Most members leave with new friends and a story, and many with plans to meet again.
Will I be paired with someone I don't like?
Early pairs are random and change every activity. After each date you give the host private feedback, and they use it to shape the next pairings. You can pass on any card, game or date.
Which language is the trip in?
Each season runs in English or Russian, and the trip page says which. Hosts speak both for season one.
No. Prices cover the land program: rooms, transfers, most meals, every activity, your host and the card decks. We'll suggest arrival and departure times.
Only flagship seasons, clearly marked in advance. Filming needs your signed release, and private dates, rooms and your picks are never filmed. You can say no and still come.
How do you keep people safe?

Every applicant has a call with a host and an ID check, and signs the code of conduct. Rooms are single with your own key, a trained host travels with every group and can remove anyone, and licensed transfers take you home after every night out.
Can I come with a friend?
Yes, apply separately and mention each other in your application. You'll be in different pairs for activities, which is half the fun.

The €500 deposit is refundable for 14 days after acceptance. After that, cancellations more than 60 days out lose the deposit; within 60 days the full price is due unless your seat is filled from the same list. Travel insurance is required.
What happens if a trip is cancelled?
If we cancel, you get everything you paid us back in full, or a seat on another season if you prefer.

What every member agrees to before they travel
Treat every member, host, guide and local partner with respect. No harassment, pressure or unwanted contact, in person or online.
Interest is shown, never assumed. A no, a pass or silence is a no. Anyone can pass on any card, game or date without giving a reason.
Everyone has a single room with their own key. Games and group activities never take place in bedrooms.
Nobody is pushed to drink and no game involves alcohol. The host may step in if anyone is unable to look after themselves.
Don't photograph or post other members without their permission. Picks, feedback and the Reveal stay private.
You confirm you are single and over 18, and that what you tell us in your application is true.
Tell your host or contact the founders directly at any time. Hosts may remove anyone who breaks this code, at that person's own cost and without refund.
What we collect, why, and what you can ask us to do with it
Tringles runs small-group trips for singles. Our address is
. We decide how the personal data described here is used and are responsible for it. Write to us about anything on this page at tringles@tourground.com.

Your name, email and a phone or messaging contact; your country, city, age range and which list you apply on; your languages; what you're looking for, interests, activity level, optional dietary, room or accessibility needs; your answers about safety and consent; a short note about yourself and an optional Instagram handle. If you subscribe to the newsletter, your email address.
Why we use it, and on what basis

To review your application, balance each cohort, plan the trip around your needs and contact you about it: steps you ask us to take before a contract. Once you book, to run your trip: performance of our contract. Dietary, health and accessibility details only with your explicit consent, which you can withdraw. Records the law requires us to keep: legal obligation. Newsletters only if you opt in.
What we never ask for here
Passport numbers, card or bank details, or anything else not listed above. ID checks happen later on a call, and payments by a separate secure link.

Only those who need it: your host, the hotels, transport and activity partners who deliver your trip (for example dietary or access needs), and the companies that provide our email, forms and website hosting. Your application is never visible to other applicants. We never sell your data.

Our trips run in Portugal, Brazil, Indonesia and Kenya, so the partners there receive what they need to look after you. Where the law requires it, we put appropriate safeguards in place for those transfers, or rely on the transfer being necessary to arrange the trip you asked for.

Applications that do not lead to a booking are deleted within two years of our last contact. Booking records are kept for as long as tax and accounting law requires. Health, dietary and access details are deleted once your trip is over.

You can ask to see, correct or delete your data, limit or object to how we use it, take a copy with you, and withdraw consent at any time. Write to tringles@tourground.com; we reply within one month. You can also complain to the data protection authority where you live, in Portugal the CNPD.
We update this policy when our practices change and show the date at the top of the page. Last updated 30 October 2026.

Applying is free and doesn't guarantee a seat. Each cohort is balanced between lists and selected after a short call with a host. If we offer you a seat, the offer sets out the trip, the price and how long it stays open.

Prices are “from” prices, per person, land only, and are confirmed when your seat is offered. A €500 deposit holds your seat; the balance is due 60 days before departure. If the balance is not paid on time, we may treat the seat as cancelled by you.
We will try to help if you want to change trips or dates, but cannot promise to. Any cost from our partners is passed on, and we tell you before you decide.

Cancel in writing at any time. The deposit is refundable for 14 days after acceptance. After that, cancellations more than 60 days before departure lose the deposit; within 60 days the full price is due unless your seat is filled from the same list.
If we change or cancel a trip

Hosts may change part of a program for safety, weather or availability, replacing it with something of similar value. If we cancel a trip, you get everything you paid us back in full, or a seat on another season if you prefer. We are not responsible for events no one could foresee or avoid, such as extreme weather, epidemics or official advice against travel; if such an event stops a trip we refund what we can recover.
Travel insurance covering cancellation, medical treatment and repatriation is required from the moment you book.

You are responsible for a valid passport, any visa, the vaccinations and health documents your trip needs, and meeting the entry rules of every country you pass through. Check them with official sources before you travel.
Every member agrees to the Code of Conduct. Breaking it can mean removal from the trip without refund. Only seasons announced as filmed are filmed, and only members who sign a release appear.

We plan and run every trip with reasonable skill and care. We are not responsible where a problem is caused by you, by someone unconnected with the trip, or by events beyond anyone's control. Where international conventions limit the liability of airlines or hotels, ours is limited in the same way. Nothing here limits liability for death or personal injury caused by negligence, or anything else that cannot be limited by law.
Tell your host straight away so it can be put right on the spot. If you are still unhappy, write to tringles@tourground.com within 28 days of coming home; we reply within 28 days.
These terms are governed by the law of Portugal, where Tringles is established. This does not take away any rights you have under the consumer law of the country where you live.
What this site stores in your browser, listed exactly

tringles-apply (local storage, set by this site): keeps your application draft on your own device so you can finish it later. It is strictly necessary for the form and is deleted when you send your application or clear your browser storage.
This site sets no cookies and runs no analytics, advertising or social-media trackers. Fonts and photographs are served from this site.

Because the only item stored is strictly necessary for a feature you choose to use, there is nothing to consent to. If we ever add anything optional, such as analytics, we will ask you first and list it here. You can clear this site's storage at any time in your browser settings.
